Store Management System

For:Shop owners who track stock and sales by hand.

Overview

A digital system that helps offline store owners move away from manual records and keep inventory and revenue information in one place.

Operating Model

Internal tool for offline stores, not an online store.. This is an internal tool for running your shop, not a customer-facing online store. Exact features are agreed based on your store's needs.

Scope & Key Deliverables

  • 01A more organised view of your inventory

Primary Business Benefit

A clearer picture of your stock and sales.
